about: OPT-IN machine checks per lane (lead ruling D1, 2026-11-07: a lane gets the ADDITIVE version of a check proposed by its critic; default off everywhere else, so deploy gates and every pinned baseline read as before). ws-precritic --skill adds a lane's args to the named gate rows ONLY when the scope holds that lane's skills, with --rule-skills <the scope's skills of that lane>, so a rule judges only the opted-in lane's skills and never turns another lane's --skill run red on skills it did not opt in. Gate ids are ws-precritic's (print-lint-kit = size L independent, print-lint-kit-S / -M, node-lint-s1, slot-clip, screen-slots, options-render). Each rule's backtest is a row of tests/fixtures/precritic/backtests.json. Another lane opts in by appending its own entry (its critic named the rule; its own skills).

lanes.why: critic r1 (design/audit/runs/lf-placevalue/critic-r1.md section 5): F1 H13-ABS, F3 WRONG-FITS per slot, F7 SCREEN-DIGIT, F9 GRID-EVEN-ALL, F10 SLOT-W-EQUAL, F15 DRAW-CAP, F19 / F20 options-render bands; critic r2 (critic-r2.md): N1 WRONG-DIFFERS, N2 PRINTED-INSTRUCTION, N3 COMBINE-PARTS, N4 PLACE-WORD-LIVE (ws-providers-unit --pv-r2); critic r2 N5 options-render --band-h13 (H13-ABS judged absolutely on band pages), N6 ws-cell-checks --h13-abs (option pages), N7 H13-ABS / GRID-EVEN-ALL on the lesson and review rows (review rows added for the lane's skills: newRow), N8 ws-coverage-matrix --red-no-baseline PAGEFILL,H5; lead 2026-11-08: ws-detailed-lesson --check on every passed detailed lesson dealing a pv skill (lesson 1 --check and --repeats, lessons 3 / 5a / 5b / 6 --check); critic r3c E-A1: ws-empty-band --vocab-ink (EB-VOCAB, a lesson vocabulary picture drawn in under 70 % of its box); critic r4 E-r4-1: ws-empty-band --page-fill (EB-PAGE); critic r3b G5: ws-fixit-words (FIX-WORDS); critic nwf r1 (critic-nwf1.md): N9 ws-empty-band --screen-parity (EB-PARITY), N2 / N4 / N5 / N7 / N8 ws-cell-checks --words-rules (CLAIM-INK, ROW-SLOT-Y, MODEL-ANSWER, WORDS-TEXT, WORDS-BREAK); N6 is ws-lesson-unit chant-box (always on)

lanes.why: facts-roles critic r1 (design/audit/runs/lf-ops/critic-factroles-r1.md): S1 MOD-MARKS (adjacent Scripted Model states draw the same picture), S2 MOD-LINES (a step text over 2 lines), S3 EB-PAGE on the Scripted Model page (under 70 % used; lead ruling 2026-11-12: a second worked example). ws-empty-band --model-states judges the three on the scripted-model render of these skills only.

r4 probe (design/status/lf-ops-props.md 'Round r4'): the bands on the array / count-row pages came from row STRETCH - practice.js spreadRows, the guided rows and the lesson Practice capFill ignored the footprint's `noStretch` (lead ruling 2026-11-12 (b)). ROW-STRETCH (ws-print-lint, opt-in) holds a row of noStretch templates to 1.25 x its tallest item (1.42 on a pageCap page) and its shortest item's band to 20 %, on every grid role at S / M / L and on the lane skills' lesson pages. The independent page is judged on the print-lint-kit rows (L / S / M); the other grid roles on print-lint-rowstretch-<size>. Screen: ws-screen-slots --screen-digit (SCREEN-DIGIT + TRAIN-FIT, lead ruling (a) 2026-11-13: the count-row train at the digit floor, no sideways scroll, no ink past its cell).
